audience: private: the seat's own open private sheet; loaded whole on every player phone whatever the role

assets.name: lib-ship-cartridge
assets.about: The ship hack's cartridge, unlocked and not used: its LED lit. In the Hacker's file once a correct final Code unlocks it.

assets.name: lib-ship-cartridge-sealed
assets.about: The ship hack's cartridge, locked: sealed in an evidence bag until a correct final Code. Not an action.

assets.name: lib-ship-cartridge-used
assets.about: The ship hack's cartridge after its one activation: scorched, LED dark. Kept in the Hacker's file.

assets.name: lib-ship-jack
assets.about: The ship's navigation port, its slot empty: where the ship hack's cartridge goes. A neutral Y for the route; no side, no direction.

assets.name: lib-ship-jack-seated
assets.about: The ship's navigation port with the cartridge seated and its lamps lit: the ship hack registered for this round's navigation.

assets.name: lib-breach-spark
assets.about: Sparks at the port as the cartridge seats (the breach). Private: on the Hacker's own phone only.

assets.name: lib-icon-ship-hack
assets.about: The tray's mark for the ship hack: a cartridge into a port. Drawn only where the seat's own view offers the action.

assets.name: lib-code-punch
assets.about: The punch a registered final Code leaves on the dossier's Code card: it says the one attempt is spent, never whether it was right.

assets.name: lib-viewfinder
assets.about: The Engineer's viewfinder over the opposite room as it is now: brackets and a centre mark, never a target on one person.

assets.name: lib-capture-print
assets.about: The Engineer's capture, developed: the print of the opposite room at the moment the server registered it. Its window shows the picture under it.

assets.name: lib-clamp
assets.about: The Engineer's signal clamp, not yet used: its wave whole and its LED lit. In the Engineer's file.

assets.name: lib-clamp-used
assets.about: The Engineer's signal clamp after its one capture: closed, its wave cut and its LED dark.

assets.name: lib-icon-capture
assets.about: The tray's mark for the Engineer's capture: a viewfinder over a cut wave. Drawn only where the seat's own view offers the action.
